steps.name: environment
steps.description: Validate Node (>=18) and npm presence, emit versions, persist NODE_ENV=development idempotently into /etc/profile.d using an atomic sudo move with robust tmp cleanup. Do not persist npm global PATH (documented). Ensure the canonical workspace directory exists. Operates in /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/hello-world-extension-2334-2350/vscode_extension_native.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/hello-world-extension-2334-2350/vscode_extension_native" # authoritative workspace
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: node not found" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: npm not found" >&2; exit 3; }
echo "node $(node --version)"; echo "npm $(npm --version)"
MAJOR=$(node -e "console.log(process.versions.node.split('.')[0])") || { echo "ERROR: unable to determine node major" >&2; exit 4; }
if [ "${MAJOR}" -lt 18 ]; then echo "ERROR: Node major version >=18 required (found ${MAJOR})" >&2; exit 5; fi
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/vscode_extension_env.sh
TMP=$(mktemp -p /tmp vscode_ext_env.XXXXXX) || { echo "ERROR: cannot create tmp" >&2; exit 6; }
trap 'rm -f "$TMP" || true' EXIT
cat > "$TMP" <<'EOF'
# NODE_ENV for VSCode extension development
export NODE_ENV=development
EOF
# Only replace if content differs (use sudo for /etc/profile.d)
if ! sudo test -f "$PROFILE" || ! sudo cmp -s "$TMP" "$PROFILE"; then sudo mv "$TMP" "$PROFILE" && sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE"; else rm -f "$TMP"; fi
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
# Note: We intentionally do NOT persist npm global PATH here. Local project binaries are preferred.
exit 0

steps.name: dependencies
steps.description: Merge required devDependencies idempotently and install them. Required: typescript, @types/node (aligned to runtime), vscode, @types/vscode, @vscode/test-electron, vsce, esbuild (optional), mocha, chai. Capture npm install logs on failure and retry once. Emit compatibility warnings for engines.vscode vs vscode devDependency and @types/node vs runtime Node version.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/hello-world-extension-2334-2350/vscode_extension_native"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Desired devDependencies
node <<'NODE'
const fs=require('fs');const p='package.json';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('package.json missing');process.exit(2);}const obj=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p));obj.devDependencies=obj.devDependencies||{};const req={"typescript":"^5.0.0","@types/node":"^18.0.0","vscode":"^1.1.65","@types/vscode":"^1.80.0","@vscode/test-electron":"^2.0.0","vsce":"^2.0.0","esbuild":"^0.18.0","mocha":"^10.0.0","chai":"^4.0.0"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(req)){if(!obj.devDependencies[k]){obj.devDependencies[k]=req[k];changed=true}}if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(obj,null,2));
NODE
# Use npm ci when lockfile exists for deterministic install
INSTALL_LOG=$(mktemp -p /tmp npm_install_log.XXXXXX) || { echo "ERROR: cannot create tmp log" >&2; exit 6; }
trap 'rm -f "$INSTALL_LOG" || true' EXIT
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >"$INSTALL_LOG" 2>&1 || (tail -n 200 "$INSTALL_LOG" >&2; echo "npm ci failed, retrying with npm i" >&2; npm i --no-audit --no-fund >"$INSTALL_LOG" 2>&1 || (tail -n 200 "$INSTALL_LOG" >&2; exit 7)); else npm i --no-audit --no-fund >"$INSTALL_LOG" 2>&1 || (tail -n 200 "$INSTALL_LOG" >&2; echo "npm i failed on first attempt, retrying" >&2; npm i --no-audit --no-fund >"$INSTALL_LOG" 2>&1 || (tail -n 200 "$INSTALL_LOG" >&2; exit 8)); fi
# Verify local binaries
TSC=./node_modules/.bin/tsc
VSCE=./node_modules/.bin/vsce
MOCHA=./node_modules/.bin/mocha
[ -x "$TSC" ] || { echo "ERROR: local tsc missing" >&2; exit 9; }
# vsce may not be executable in some versions; warn if missing
if [ -x "$VSCE" ]; then "$VSCE" --version || true; else echo "WARNING: local vsce missing; packaging will fallback to npx --yes vsce" >&2; fi
[ -d node_modules/@vscode/test-electron ] || { echo "ERROR: @vscode/test-electron not installed" >&2; exit 10; }
# Compatibility checks
node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if(p.engines && p.engines.vscode && p.devDependencies && p.devDependencies.vscode){console.log('engines.vscode='+p.engines.vscode+', devDependency vscode='+p.devDependencies.vscode);}"
# Check @types/node vs runtime
NODE_MAJOR=$(node -e "console.log(process.versions.node.split('.')[0])")
if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 20 ]; then echo "NOTE: using @types/node ^18 to match Node ${NODE_MAJOR} runtime";
fi
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/hello-world-extension-2334-2350/vscode_extension_native"

  "name": "hello-world-extension",
  "version": "0.0.1",
  "engines": { "vscode": "^1.80.0" },

  "scripts": { "vscode:prepublish": "npm run build", "build": "tsc -p .", "test": "mocha --timeout 10000" }

if [ ! -f tsconfig.json ]; then cat > tsconfig.json <<'TS'
{

if [ ! -f src/extension.ts ]; then cat > src/extension.ts <<'TS'

fi

node_modules
.vscode
.vscode-test
.out
VSI
fi
# Merge required devDependencies idempotently, aligning @types/node major to runtime
node <<'NODE'
const fs=require('fs');const p='package.json';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('package.json missing');process.exit(2);}const obj=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p));obj.devDependencies=obj.devDependencies||{};const semverNode=process.versions.node.split('.')[0];const typesNodeMajor=(+semverNode)>=20?"^20.0.0":"^18.0.0";const req={"typescript":"^5.0.0","@types/node":typesNodeMajor,"vscode":"^1.1.65","@types/vscode":"^1.80.0","@vscode/test-electron":"^2.0.0","vsce":"^2.0.0","esbuild":"^0.18.0","mocha":"^10.0.0","chai":"^4.0.0"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(req)){if(!obj.devDependencies[k]){obj.devDependencies[k]=req[k];changed=true}}if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(obj,null,2));
NODE
# Install with log capture and one retry
INSTALL_LOG=$(mktemp -p /tmp npm_install_log.XXXXXX) || { echo "ERROR: cannot create tmp log" >&2; exit 6; }
trap 'rm -f "$INSTALL_LOG" || true' EXIT
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >"$INSTALL_LOG" 2>&1 || (tail -n 200 "$INSTALL_LOG" >&2; echo "npm ci failed, retrying with npm i" >&2; npm i --no-audit --no-fund >"$INSTALL_LOG" 2>&1 || (tail -n 200 "$INSTALL_LOG" >&2; exit 7))
else
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund >"$INSTALL_LOG" 2>&1 || (tail -n 200 "$INSTALL_LOG" >&2; echo "npm i failed on first attempt, retrying" >&2; npm i --no-audit --no-fund >"$INSTALL_LOG" 2>&1 || (tail -n 200 "$INSTALL_LOG" >&2; exit 8))
fi
# Verify local binaries
TSC=./node_modules/.bin/tsc
MOCHA=./node_modules/.bin/mocha
VSCE=./node_modules/.bin/vsce
[ -x "$TSC" ] || { echo "ERROR: local tsc missing" >&2; exit 9; }
# vsce may not be executable in some npm layouts; warn if missing
if [ -x "$VSCE" ]; then "$VSCE" --version || true; else echo "WARNING: local vsce missing; packaging will fallback to npx --yes vsce" >&2; fi
[ -d node_modules/@vscode/test-electron ] || { echo "ERROR: @vscode/test-electron not installed" >&2; exit 10; }
# Compatibility checks and warnings
node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if(p.engines && p.engines.vscode && p.devDependencies && p.devDependencies.vscode){if(p.engines.vscode!==p.devDependencies.vscode)console.warn('WARNING: engines.vscode='+p.engines.vscode+' differs from devDependency vscode='+p.devDependencies.vscode);}"
NODE_MAJOR=$(node -e "console.log(process.versions.node.split('.')[0])")
if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 20 ]; then echo "NOTE: using @types/node ^18 to match Node ${NODE_MAJOR} runtime"; fi
exit 0
